notes: [REDACTION-NEEDED NOISE] Round 9 phantom Landing values kept verbatim in scores-raw: exactly 12 of the 14 R9 rows carry Landing=145.0, and six of those twelve ALSO carry FlightScoreDeduction=200.0. There is NO landing scheme attached anywhere in this comp's schema — the F3K family row has no landing/scheme reference field, Scores exposes no scheme-ref column, LndgNames/LndgPoints are keyed only by LndgNo+Name without any CompNo link, so nothing about these cells is interpretable as landing-bonus evidence. R9 is also heavily auto-filled: all 14 rows share one time/laps set and RawScore takes only three values {210, 405, 525}. Do NOT read Landing=145.0 here as a real touchdown distance, do NOT read FlightScoreDeduction=200 as a real penalty, and an F3K-family score validator must NOT hard-code slot-sum or landing expectations off this fixture. validate.py rule 2 applies vacuously to this fixture (rule keys off the Dur family row; this comp has none).

Mid-comp retirement carried as a first-class observation: CompPilots PilotNo=89 has Retired=true (Role Plt, PilotClass Sprt); his last score rows are at R8, and he is wholly ABSENT from R9–R15 — silent absence with zero placeholder stubs (verified). His earlier R4G2 row is RawScore=0 with Updated='True', the comp's sole accepted-as-flown zero. Group sizes consequently run 5/5/5 through R8 then 5/5/4 from R9. WI-3 owns retired-pilot ladder-aggregation semantics; any loader claiming 'every entered pilot scores each round' or requiring dense draw-matrix keys is wrong by design.

Task catalogue verbatim from F3KTaskByRound over rounds 1–15: K, I, A(2), E, H, G, J, C(1), D, F, B(1), H, G, B(2), C(1). Letters E, I, J and K are FIRST corpus sightings; sub-numbered variants A(2)/B(1)/B(2)/C(1) confirmed; A(1) does NOT occur here. Scores.TaskNo stays constant 5 on all 218 rows — task identity lives entirely in F3KTaskByRound, decoupled from the numeric column, same as f3k-sample-comp; loaders must join via F3KTaskByRound and never infer tasks from Scores.

Per-group normalisation invariant verified again at curation on all 218/218 rows: NormalisedScore == round(1000 x RawScore / best-Raw-in-group, 1 dp) across all 45 round-groups x 11 task letters, including degenerate R9. Winners: 35 groups with a unique NS==1000.0 winner and 10 tied-winner groups (tie widths 2–5, including R9G1 whole-group 5-way tie @405 and R9G2 4-way @525); 64 rows sit at exactly NS 1000.0. F3K normalisation basis is per-GROUP throughout.

Precision: combined RawScore+NormalisedScore decimal tails split 301 zero-dp / 135 one-dp values (218 Raw all integral; 83 NS integral, 135 NS one-dp) — exact candidate-split reproduction. Persisted doubles carry zero string-repr residue; a binary32 persist-cast simulation would flip 120/217 positive NS representations, so assert ONLY on persisted values, never simulated cast bits.

Faithful-null scoring knobs: GroupScoreOption, GroupScoreDecimals, RoundOrTruncate, DropScoreOption, Drop1AtRound and Drop2AtRound persist as Jet-null in the Comps row (carried verbatim in competition.json scoring), while Drop3..Drop5AtRound=99 and F3QDrop6to10='99,99,99,99,99'. Despite the nulls the scores were demonstrably computed normally — the invariant note above holds 218/218 with one-dp tails — so GS's effective grid was empirically points-normalisation rounded to 1 dp. Carry the arithmetic-story guard ('Decs outside {0..3} zeroes/stales scores') into any replay assertions rather than assuming defaults. No drop threshold can fire here (configured state unset/99 throughout). CompDate is likewise Jet-null: no comp date exists anywhere.

Uniform row states: Updated='True' on all 218 rows (Text-typed, as in f3k-sample-comp — rescoring gate open throughout); Penalty=0 everywhere; LandingOver75m nowhere true; ScoresChecked=false everywhere (inert evidence under our no-sign-off trust model); Helper is Jet-null on every row; ReFlightNo>0 nowhere; OriginalRoundNo==RoundNo everywhere (no re-flights); ModelID='' and Flight1..Flight4=null on every row.

Family-row format drift worth knowing before comparison work: F3K.f3kPilotsMin holds CSV '0,1,0,1' here, unlike f3k-sample-comp's query-string style ('TmProt=True&NbrPlts=10&GrpsInRnd=4...'), and draws no counts from it — pilot/group shape is witnessed from the Scores rows instead: 45 round-group pairs, 3 groups in every round of all 15 rounds, 15 pilots. The F3K row is otherwise the corpus-normal shape (draw/timing state only, no scoring knobs); dur/spd/dis/f5b/f5k families have zero rows for comp 17 (pure F3K comp).
